title: Agents in production.
subtitle: An agent system run daily since early 2026 — Suchbot is its public face.
overview: A larger experiment in giving an agent useful context, and improving its behavior through daily use.
decisions: A service around existing notes, rather than a separate knowledge silo. A mobile interface for quick capture. Journal upkeep shaped around conversation, because that’s how I naturally work.
limitations: A small, self-hosted system with ongoing maintenance. Logseq syntax, indexing, and mobile caching required iteration. The public template is an untested alpha; it is not a finished enterprise product.

subsystems.title: Shared knowledge graph
subsystems.text: Logseq holds the notes my agent and I work from. I initiated logseqd — a Clojure/DataScript service that makes the graph queryable by the agent and other tools — then added a mobile interface for capture and review.

subsystems.title: Feedback loops
subsystems.text: Repeated writing corrections became a mechanical check before publication. Public interactions can consult explicitly published pages; a server-side gate keeps private documents out of that path.

subsystems.title: Division of labor
subsystems.text: I initiate the work, set workflow and interface requirements, and test in daily use. Hermes contributes substantially to implementation.
